text:
### Internal Network Segmentation  
**Network Segregation:**
- Customer-facing systems: Separate subnet
- Internal staff systems: Separate subnet
- Database tier: Isolated, restricted access
- Development systems: Separated from production  
**VPN & Bastion Hosts:**
- Remote access through VPN only
- Bastion host for admin access
- Multi-hop authentication
- Session logging and timeout

raw_entities.name: Internal Network Segmentation Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the segregation and isolation of internal banking networks to protect customer-facing systems, staff systems, databases, and development environments from unauthorized access and cross-system compromise.

raw_entities.name: Customer-Facing Systems Network Isolation
raw_entities.description: Requirement that customer-facing systems must operate on a separate subnet from other internal systems to prevent unauthorized access and maintain system integrity.

raw_entities.name: Internal Staff Systems Network Isolation
raw_entities.description: Requirement that internal staff systems must operate on a separate subnet from customer-facing systems and other critical infrastructure.

raw_entities.name: Database Tier Isolation and Access Restriction
raw_entities.description: Requirement that the database tier must be isolated from other network segments with restricted access controls to prevent unauthorized data access.

raw_entities.name: Development Systems Separation from Production
raw_entities.description: Requirement that development systems must be segregated from production systems to prevent untested code or configurations from affecting live customer services.

raw_entities.name: Remote Access via VPN Only
raw_entities.description: Requirement that all remote access to internal systems must be conducted exclusively through a Virtual Private Network to ensure encrypted and authenticated connections.

raw_entities.name: Bastion Host for Administrative Access
raw_entities.description: Requirement that administrative access to internal systems must be routed through a bastion host to provide a controlled gateway and audit point for privileged operations.

raw_entities.name: Multi-Hop Authentication for Remote Access
raw_entities.description: Requirement that remote access authentication must employ multi-hop authentication mechanisms to strengthen identity verification and prevent unauthorized access.

raw_entities.name: Session Logging and Timeout for Remote Access
raw_entities.description: Requirement that all remote access sessions must be logged for audit purposes and configured with automatic timeout to prevent unauthorized prolonged access.

raw_entities.name: Network Subnet Segregation
raw_entities.description: Technical control implementing the separation of customer-facing systems, internal staff systems, database tier, and development systems into isolated network subnets to prevent unauthorized cross-system access.

raw_entities.name: VPN Remote Access Gateway
raw_entities.description: Technical control requiring all remote access to internal systems to be encrypted and authenticated through a Virtual Private Network gateway.

raw_entities.name: Bastion Host Access Control
raw_entities.description: Technical control implementing a hardened gateway server through which all administrative access to internal systems must be routed, providing centralized authentication and audit logging.

raw_entities.name: Multi-Hop Authentication
raw_entities.description: Technical control requiring multiple sequential authentication steps for remote access to strengthen identity verification and prevent unauthorized access.

raw_entities.name: Session Logging and Audit Trail
raw_entities.description: Technical control that records all remote access sessions for audit and forensic purposes, enabling detection and investigation of unauthorized access attempts.

raw_entities.name: Session Timeout Mechanism
raw_entities.description: Technical control that automatically terminates idle remote access sessions after a defined period to prevent unauthorized use of abandoned connections.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Network Access
raw_entities.description: Risk that attackers or unauthorized internal users could gain access to customer-facing systems, staff systems, or databases through inadequate network segregation.

raw_entities.name: Cross-System Compromise
raw_entities.description: Risk that a compromise of one network segment could spread to other critical systems if development, production, customer-facing, and internal systems are not properly segregated.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Remote Access
raw_entities.description: Risk that remote users could gain unauthorized access to internal systems through unencrypted connections or weak authentication mechanisms.

raw_entities.name: Privileged Access Abuse
raw_entities.description: Risk that administrative users could abuse their elevated privileges to access unauthorized systems or data without detection.

properties.core_policy_statement: The bank implements network segmentation to isolate customer-facing systems, internal staff systems, database tier, and development systems, with controlled remote access via VPN and bastion hosts using multi-hop authentication and session logging.
properties.scope_summary: Applies to all network infrastructure including customer-facing systems, internal staff systems, database tier, and development environments. Excludes non-networked systems.

properties.core_requirement: Customer-facing systems must operate on a separate subnet from other network tiers
Internal staff systems must operate on a separate subnet from customer-facing and database systems

properties.name: Database Tier Isolation and Access Restriction

properties.core_requirement: Database tier must be isolated with restricted access controls limiting connectivity to authorized systems only
Development systems must be separated from production systems to prevent unauthorized code or configuration changes
All remote access to internal systems must be conducted exclusively through VPN
Administrative access must be routed through a bastion host as a controlled access point
Remote access must require multi-hop authentication to verify user identity across multiple authentication stages

properties.name: Session Logging and Timeout for Remote Access

properties.core_requirement: All remote access sessions must be logged and subject to automatic timeout to prevent unauthorized session persistence

properties.core_function: Isolates customer-facing systems, internal staff systems, database tier, and development systems into separate subnets
Enforces encrypted remote access through VPN gateway as the sole entry point for remote users
Routes administrative access through a hardened bastion host to control and monitor privileged access
Requires multiple authentication stages for remote and administrative access to verify user identity

properties.evidence_required: Complete audit trail of all remote and administrative sessions
properties.core_function: Records all remote access and administrative session activity for audit and forensic investigation
Automatically terminates idle remote sessions to prevent unauthorized session persistence

properties.risk_definition: Attackers or unauthorized users gaining access to internal network segments or systems they should not have access to
examples: Lateral movement from customer-facing systems to internal staff systems
Direct access to database tier without authorization
Unauthorized access to production systems from development environment
detection_mechanism: Network segmentation prevents unauthorized lateral movement
Access control logs identify unauthorized access attempts
properties.required_response: Immediate isolation of affected systems and investigation of access logs

properties.risk_definition: Compromise of one network segment leading to unauthorized access to other segments or systems
examples: Attacker compromising customer-facing system and using it to pivot to internal systems
Malware spreading from development to production environment
Database breach through compromised internal staff system
detection_mechanism: Session logging detects suspicious cross-segment activity
properties.required_response: Immediate containment, forensic investigation, and system remediation

properties.risk_definition: Unauthorized users or attackers gaining remote access to internal systems bypassing security controls
examples: Compromised credentials used for remote access
Session hijacking or replay attacks on remote sessions
detection_mechanism: VPN gateway enforces encryption and authentication
Session logging detects anomalous remote access patterns
properties.required_response: Session termination, credential reset, and investigation of access logs

properties.risk_definition: Misuse of administrative or privileged access by authorized users or compromised privileged accounts
examples: Administrator accessing systems beyond their authorization scope
Privileged account credentials compromised and used maliciously
Unauthorized administrative actions on production systems
detection_mechanism: Bastion host centralizes administrative access for monitoring
Session logging records all administrative actions
properties.required_response: Immediate account suspension, session termination, and comprehensive audit of administrative actions
